finalText:
Same-key repeats within 5 minutes are dropped: 99 dropped (the flap events, which fire 2 min after their predecessor), 0 errors.

Details: `state.lastSent` is a Map of key → last delivery time, updated only when a notification actually goes out, so a dropped repeat doesn't extend the window. Queued (quiet-hour) deliveries count as sent. I used `<= 5` minutes as "within the last 5 minutes"; a repeat at exactly +5 is dropped, +6 goes through.
